scope: Independent narrow geometry/design review of original 01/07/09/14 on holonomic swerve

sources.kind: previously read first-party text; author-reported, not measured

swerve.localInvariance: R rotates mechanism, full piece and relative approach velocity together; dot products, distances and local velocity geometry are invariant

checks.source: family-a.json id01 plan.guides Left/Right fixed V guide bank
checks.type: analytic geometry and possible force-symmetry counterexample
checks.result: Unchanged horizontal alpha90 cannot pass; symmetric head-on passive reactions can have zero yaw moment
checks.next: Test symmetric alpha90, mirrored perturbations, low-momentum transitions and reversal; active indexer revision permitted

checks.source: family-c.json id09 plan.guides banks and side.rollers short deck wheels
checks.type: necessary projected overlap only, not traction
checks.allYawProof: Witness distance sqrt(30^2+20^2)<D/2<=L/2; pipe rectangle contains that disk at every alpha, witnesses strictly inside both middle-row rectangles
checks.projectionInterpretation: Literal horizontal finite cylinders: widths from plan banks, row radii/heights from side. Convex clipping of the exact pipe plan rectangle against six wheel rectangles; not a solid model or measured contact patch.
checks.result: Both banks covered for all alpha at center(0,200), not all offsets or the entire path; projected last-row contact does not end at terminal435 for alpha0

checks.source: family-c.json id09 side.rollers z164.85/r28, deck z192.85, pipe path z250
checks.type: literal rigid-cylinder contact counterexample, not measured hardware failure
checks.result: At alpha0 rigid bottom generator lies between banks: silhouette overlap does not establish wheel contact. Protrusion/support/preload geometry needs revision or evidence.

checks.source: family-c.json id07 plan.guides y125/475, shelf145/455, pipe gamma0 at y300
checks.result: Aligned side capture intent with limited offset margin; 350 vs510 is not a measured acquisition comparison or an intrinsic side penalty

checks.source: concept-14.json plan fingers x+/-155, side rollers and receiver
checks.yawErrorFormula: L*cos(delta)+OD*sin(delta)=310, first positive delta from crosswise; centered horizontal pipe and drawn closed fingers only
checks.closedFingerFiveDegreeCounterexample: Exact rectangle crosses x+/-155 within straight-finger y=-10..105 at offer center(0,37.85); possible closure interference, not measured failure
checks.lowerRotationReference: locked to moving carrier, not world-fixed
checks.result: Capture/raise/centering can remove a separate orienter only after orientation capture, retention, closure and receiver alignment are established

proposedFirstMatrix.longitudinalCoverage: pickup, transition, capture, retained transfer/raise, hold, handoff, return; include between-sample swept bounds
proposedFirstMatrix.speedStatus: PROPOSED_NOT_MEASURED; set and log numeric safe rig conditions before executing

required: constant part lengths and real motion axes/constrained slides
explicit states and retained full-piece/contact path
full-piece and hardware bumper/frame/receiver sweeps with between-pose bounds
positive-margin extension<=457.2 from perimeter and start height<=1066.8
open/stowed/handoff views plus preserved original 2D flow

decision.carryMountComparison: 14 vs07 may mix mechanism and mount choices; compare mount as an independent axis
narrowed: 09 must solve real contact despite useful projected bank coverage
07 legitimate side-access contender with nominal mouth margins
14 must prove capture and retention before claiming orientation-module elimination
decision.selectionCondition: Only nominate two meaningfully distinct finalists after discriminating tests and bounded geometry-ready gates; then stop for user selection

validation.method: Node built-ins, source-coordinate assertions, exact convex rectangle clipping, analytic all-alpha proof; no extra files
validation.precisionNote: Initial probe used 1e-7 mm tolerance against six-decimal 14 roller coordinates; corrected to 1e-6 and rerun PASS. This was a probe precision failure, not a physical test failure.
nodeProbe: const fs = require('node:fs'), assert = require('node:assert/strict'), crypto = require('node:crypto'), path = require('node:path');
let count = 0; const check = (condition, label) => { assert.ok(condition, label); count++; }; const near = (actual, expected, label) => check(Math.abs(actual-expected)<1e-6, label);

const get = id=>report.checks.find(item=>item.id===id), pipe=report.coordinates.pipe, halfLength=pipe.length/2, radius=pipe.radius; near(pipe.diameter/2,radius,'pipe radius'); near(pipe.length,301.625,'brief pipe length');

const throat=get('01-throat-and-symmetry'), vGuides=original01.plan.guides.filter(item=>/fixed V guide bank/.test(item.label)); near(vGuides[1].points[1][0]-vGuides[0].points[1][0],throat.throat,'source throat'); near(pipe.length-throat.throat,throat.crosswiseExcess,'crosswise excess'); near(throat.throat-pipe.diameter,throat.lengthwiseTotalClearance,'aligned clearance');

const deck=get('09-exact-rectangle-bank-overlap'), wheels=original09.side.rollers.filter(item=>item.center[1]===164.85); check(JSON.stringify(banks.map(bank=>[bank.minX,bank.maxX]))===JSON.stringify(deck.bankX),'source bank positions'); check(banks.every(bank=>bank.maxX-bank.minX===60 && bank.minY===40 && bank.maxY===320),'source bank sizes'); check(JSON.stringify(wheels.map(wheel=>wheel.center[0]))===JSON.stringify(deck.wheelRowsY) && wheels.every(wheel=>wheel.radius===28),'source wheel rows');

const clip=(polygon,coordinate,bound,sign)=>{const result=[]; if(!polygon.length)return result; let previous=polygon.at(-1),previousDistance=sign*(previous[coordinate]-bound); for(const current of polygon){const distance=sign*(current[coordinate]-bound); if((previousDistance>=0)!==(distance>=0)){const fraction=previousDistance/(previousDistance-distance); result.push(previous.map((value,index)=>value+fraction*(current[index]-value)));} if(distance>=0)result.push(current); previous=current; previousDistance=distance;}return result;};

const overlap=(polygon,bounds)=>{let result=polygon; for(const [coordinate,bound,sign] of [[0,bounds.minX,1],[0,bounds.maxX,-1],[1,bounds.minY,1],[1,bounds.maxY,-1]])result=clip(result,coordinate,bound,sign);return area(result);};

let minimum=Infinity; for(let step=0;step<=900;step++){const totals=coverage(deck.allYawCenter,step/10).map(bank=>bank.reduce((sum,value)=>sum+value,0));check(totals.every(value=>value>0),'sampled bilateral yaw '+step/10);minimum=Math.min(minimum,...totals);} near(minimum,deck.allYawSampling.minimumSingleBankSummedProjectedAreaMm2,'sampled minimum');

for(const [index,point] of deck.allYawWitnesses.entries()){const middle=rows[index][1];check(point[0]>middle.minX && point[0]<middle.maxX && point[1]>middle.minY && point[1]<middle.maxY && Math.hypot(point[0]-deck.allYawCenter[0],point[1]-deck.allYawCenter[1])<radius && radius<halfLength,'analytic all-alpha witness');}

for(const result of deck.terminalAreasByYawMm2){const totals=coverage(deck.terminalCenter,result.yaw).map(bank=>bank.reduce((sum,value)=>sum+value,0));near(totals[0],result.left,'terminal left yaw '+result.yaw);near(totals[1],result.right,'terminal right yaw '+result.yaw);}

for(const result of deck.originalTargetPosesAreasByBankAndRowMm2){const actual=coverage(result.center,result.yaw);for(let bank=0;bank<2;bank++)for(let row=0;row<3;row++)near(actual[bank][row],result.areas[bank][row],'original target rectangle area');}

const contact=get('09-contact-height-counterexample');near(wheels[0].center[1]+wheels[0].radius,contact.wheelTopZ,'source wheel top');near(contact.pipeCenterZ-radius,contact.wheelTopZ,'rigid tangent plane');near(contact.pipeCenterZ-Math.sqrt(radius**2-contact.nearestBankX**2)-contact.wheelTopZ,contact.rigidVerticalGapAtNearestEdge,'positive rigid contact gap');near(435-halfLength-280,contact.terminalRearBeyondLastWheelTangentLine,'beyond apex');

const side=get('07-aligned-mouth'),mouth=original07.plan.guides[1].points[0][1]-original07.plan.guides[0].points[0][1];near(mouth,side.mouth,'side source mouth');near(mouth-pipe.length,side.totalMargin,'side total margin');near((mouth-pipe.length)/2,side.perEndMargin,'side per-end margin');near(original07.plan.guides[2].points[2][1]-original07.plan.guides[2].points[0][1],side.shelfSpan,'side shelf');near((side.shelfSpan-pipe.length)/2,side.shelfPerEndMargin,'side shelf margin');near(original01.mouthWidthMm,side.compared01FrontMouthIntent,'front intent');

const yawThreshold=(Math.atan2(pipe.diameter,pipe.length)-Math.acos(carry.closedFingerSpan/diagonal))*180/Math.PI;near(yawThreshold,carry.closedFingerFirstYawErrorInterferenceDeg,'finger yaw threshold');const skew=rectangle([0,37.85],85);const extremes=[skew.reduce((best,point)=>point[0]<best[0]?point:best),skew.reduce((best,point)=>point[0]>best[0]?point:best)];check(extremes.every(point=>Math.abs(point[0])>155 && point[1]>-10 && point[1]<105),'5deg fingers interfere within finite straight legs');

check(original14.side.rollers[0].rotation==='locked','carrier lower lock');for(const roller of original14.side.rollers)near(Math.hypot(...roller.center.map((value,index)=>value-original14.side.receiver.center[index])),radius+25,'rounded14 nip distance');

const lines=doc.trimEnd().split(/\r?\n/).length;check(lines<100 && !/[^\x00-\x7F]/.test(doc),'document line/ASCII constraints');for(const match of doc.matchAll(/[(]([.][.][/][^)]+|BRIEF[.]md|screen[.]json)[)]/g))check(fs.existsSync(path.resolve('trials/intake-finalists',match[1])),'document link');
